bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 169, Number 71 (Thursday, April 27, 2023)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. JOHNSON of Georgia:
H.R. 2953.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Article I Section 1.
The single subject of this legislation is:
This bill amends title 9 of the United States Code with
respect to arbitration, in order to prohibit predispute
arbitration agreements that force arbitration of future
employment, consumer, antitrust, or civil rights disputes,
and to prohibit agreements and practices that interfere with
the rights of individuals, workers, and small businesses to
participate in a joint, class, or collective action related
to an employment, consumer, antitrust, or civil rights
dispute.
[Page H2087]
